svg.text: Squircle mask, primary-container background. Sharp (Material Symbols "Sharp") vs rounded ("Rounded") strokes.
The launcher picks the mask. Dashed circle = the safe zone the mark must stay inside.
The launcher recolours a one-colour version of the icon to match the wallpaper. Light and dark.
In a Material top app bar (dark and light), and D enlarged on a 24-unit grid with a 2-unit stroke.
